hero.title: Shri Shivaji Agriculture College, Amravati
hero.summary: Shri Shivaji Agriculture College in Amravati is run by Shri Shivaji Education Society and affiliated to Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola. Its academic departments cover crop production, plant protection, resources and allied subjects. The college combines a longstanding regional identity with an agriculture bachelor’s programme.

overview.heading: Agricultural education rooted in Amravati
paragraphs: The college traces its founding to Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh and is managed by Shri Shivaji Education Society. Its official history records earlier affiliation to Nagpur University, followed by agricultural-university affiliation. It identifies Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola, as the present affiliating university.

Its departmental structure includes agronomy and meteorology, agricultural botany, chemistry, engineering, horticulture and plant pathology. That spread places crop production alongside weather, soils, equipment and crop health in the college’s teaching setting. The official facilities page describes library and internet resources, and the homepage also mentions postgraduate work in agricultural economics and extension. The college’s affiliation gives applicants a clear university framework for comparing its undergraduate agriculture route.

admissions.heading: Applying to Shri Shivaji Agriculture College
admissions.intro: The 2026–27 state prospectus identifies Shri Shivaji as an aided PDKV-affiliated agriculture college, institution code 11107, with an intake of 120. Admission follows the state agriculture CAP framework. Its published final admission cutoff was 17 September 2026; this historical calendar does not establish an open vacancy.
eligibility_points: B.Sc. Agriculture is a full-time four-year/eight-semester degree under the 2026–27 state framework.

faqs.question: Who manages Shri Shivaji Agriculture College?
faqs.answer: The college is run by Shri Shivaji Education Society, Amravati.

faqs.question: Which university is it affiliated to?
faqs.answer: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola.

faqs.question: Is this a university profile or a college profile?
faqs.answer: It is a college profile. PDKV is the affiliating university.

faqs.question: Which course is in the ICAR record?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, with the audited term 27 February 2025 to 26 February 2030.

faqs.question: Does the college publish a current fee amount?

faqs.question: Is the listed CAP admission window still open?
faqs.answer: The official 2026–27 schedule sets 17 September 2026 as the final admission cutoff. That date has passed; a later opportunity requires a separate official notice.
